newsitem.title: USA: Viacom names new CEO at Blockbuster.
newsitem.headline: Viacom names new CEO at Blockbuster.

text.p: Viacom Inc. said on Tuesday it named John Antioco chairman and chief executive officer of its Blockbuster Entertainment unit.

Antioco replaces Bill Fields, who resigned in April by "mutual agreement," the company said. The company warned at the time that it expected disappointing results at the chain, saying operating cash flow was likely to fall by 15 percent to 20 percent.
Antioco joins Blockbuster from Taco Bell Corp., where he was president and chief executive officer.

Viacom Chairman Sumner Redstone acknowledged last week that problems had hampered operations at the video retailer, including high costs and purchasing of videotapes, but he said executives were working to fix the problems.
Analysts see Blockbuster as trying to get back to the focus of its business: video rentals, as opposed to a variety of other merchandise, from candy to movie-related toys.
Viacom bought Blockbuster from founder Wayne Huizenga for $8 billion in 1994.
